title: An owner who paid MettleUp by UPI or bank transfer can never open the receipt for it
what: When MettleUp confirms a UPI or bank payment, the server makes a numbered receipt for it. The only list that shows these receipts sits inside the Pay online part of the Pay MettleUp screen, and that part asks the server nothing while online paying is switched off, which it is. So the owner sees Confirmed, paid until a date, but no receipt anywhere. The receipt page itself tells them to open it from Your receipts, which they cannot see.
expected: Every confirmed payment shows its receipt on Pay MettleUp, whether online paying is on or off.
fix_line: Show the gym's receipts list on Pay MettleUp even while online paying is off

title: An owner who reports paying MettleUp more or less than the price gets no word, and the extra is never marked to be paid back
what: The amount box on Pay MettleUp can be changed to anything. The screen sends it without saying it differs from the price. On HQ only a short amount gets a warning; an amount above the price is confirmed as is, the receipt shows the full amount, and nothing records that the extra is owed back, though the refunds page promises to refund it.
expected: The owner is told when the amount differs from the price, and an over-payment is marked in HQ as extra to refund.
fix_line: Warn the owner before sending a different amount, and flag an over-payment in HQ as extra to refund

title: The WhatsApp receipt and the printed receipt can show different amounts still due
what: The printed receipt shows what is still owed on that one membership. The WhatsApp receipt sent from the same screen says the member's whole amount owed across every membership is still due, with a pay link for it. A member with a second unpaid plan or PT pack gets one figure on paper and a bigger one on WhatsApp.
expected: Both copies of one receipt name the same amount still due, or say clearly which plans it covers.
fix_line: Use the same still-due amount on the printed and WhatsApp receipt

title: Adding a GST number quietly turns every plan price into a price that already includes GST
what: Settings says only that the GST number shows on receipts. Once it is saved, every receipt treats the amount paid as including GST and splits it into a smaller taxable value plus CGST and SGST. Nothing on Settings or the Plans price box says prices now include GST, so an owner who expects GST to be added on top finds less income on paper than planned.
expected: Settings and the plan price box say that with a GST number every price includes GST, and at what rate.
fix_line: Say on the GST box and the price box that prices include GST once a GST number is saved
